:bulb: *[AI]* *[welcome_screen]* Add Google/Apple sign-in buttons to welcome screen

*Category:* onboarding · *Lever:* conversion · *Impact:* High · *Effort:* Medium

Surface social sign-in options (Sign in with Apple, Continue with Google) directly on the welcome screen alongside Get Started and Login. Reduces the perceived effort of creating an account by offering one-tap authentication before the user even enters the onboarding funnel.

*Why it lifts the lever:* The current flow requires tapping Get Started, then going through onboarding before reaching account creation. Users who already trust the brand (e.g., from ads or referrals) want the fastest path in. Surfacing social auth on the landing screen captures high-intent users who would otherwise drop off during multi-step onboarding.

*Hypothesis:* If we add Apple/Google sign-in buttons on the welcome screen, then new user registration rate improves by 15-25% because reducing perceived signup friction captures high-intent users immediately.

*Hypothesis:* If we add a rotating testimonial quote above the plan cards, then free trial start rate improves by 10-15% because relatable outcome stories reduce purchase anxiety more effectively than feature lists at the commitment moment.

:bulb: *[AI]* *[dailyGrounding_screen]* Let Users Save and Replay Favorite Grounding Tracks

*Category:* personalization · *Lever:* conversion · *Impact:* High · *Effort:* medium

Add a heart/bookmark icon on the grounding screen to save loved tracks. Surface saved tracks in a 'My Grounding' library accessible from the daily card. The 'Not right?' button implies variety, but no way to revisit a track that resonated. Favorites create personal investment in the content library and increase switching cost for premium subscribers.

*Why it lifts the lever:* Grounding is deeply personal -- a track that calms one user may not work for another. The current daily-rotation model means a perfect-fit track may never resurface. Letting users curate their own set increases perceived premium value and creates an accumulating personal asset that competitors cannot replicate. The 'Not right?' affordance proves track preference variance exists.

*Hypothesis:* A favorites/replay feature will increase grounding track replay rate by 25-30%, improve 90-day premium retention by 4-6% via switching cost, and lift weekly grounding sessions by 20% among users who save at least one track.

:bulb: *[AI]* *[affirmationDetail_screen]* Add Save to Collection and Affirmation Streak

*Category:* habit_formation · *Lever:* retention · *Impact:* High · *Effort:* medium

Let users save affirmations to a personal collection and show a 'daily affirmation streak' counter. The press-and-hold ritual is perfect for habit loops but has no persistence -- yesterday's affirmation is gone. A collection gives users a reason to return daily (new affirmation + streak maintenance) and a library to revisit during tough moments.

*Why it lifts the lever:* The press-and-hold interaction creates a mindful micro-ritual, but there is no reward loop beyond the single moment. Saved collections create an accumulating personal asset that increases switching cost. Streaks leverage loss aversion -- users who have built a 14-day streak will open the app to avoid breaking it.

*Hypothesis:* Adding save-to-collection with streak display will increase daily affirmation open rate by 25-35% and improve 14-day retention by 6-10% among users who engage with the feature at least 3 times.
